mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_type, biz_key, name, avatar_url, creator_id, last_message, last_message_type, last_message_time, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM `conversation` WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT id, conversation_type, biz_key, name, avatar_url, creator_id, last_message, last_message_type, last_message_time, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM `conversation` WHERE biz_key = #{bizKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `conversation` SET last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_message_type = #{lastMessageType}, last_message_time = #{lastMessageTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `conversation_member` cm INNER JOIN `conversation` c ON c.id = cm.conversation_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 0

SELECT c.id AS conversation_id, c.conversation_type, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 'GROUP' THEN c.name ELSE target_user.username END AS conversation_name, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 'GROUP' THEN c.avatar_url ELSE target_user.avatar_url END AS conversation_avatar, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 'GROUP' THEN NULL ELSE target_user.id END AS target_user_id, c.last_message, c.last_message_type, c.last_message_time, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 'GROUP' THEN FALSE WHEN cb.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS blocked FROM `conversation_member` cm INNER JOIN `conversation` c ON c.id = cm.conversation_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN `conversation_member` other_cm ON other_cm.conversation_id = c.id AND other_cm.user_id != #{userId} AND other_cm.status = 0 AND c.conversation_type = 'SINGLE' LEFT JOIN `user` target_user ON target_user.id = other_cm.user_id AND target_user.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN `contact_block` cb ON cb.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND cb.blocked_user_id = target_user.id AND cb.status = 0 WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.created_at) DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
